📋 Key Rules to Remember

🏛️
Register at Einwohnermeldeamt within 2 weeks of moving in. Mandatory by German law — bring your passport and rental contract.
🔑
Keys: Never copy or share your key. Lost key = you pay for full lock replacement (~€80+ per door). Report loss immediately.
🚶
Moving in/out only on weekdays during office hours. Saturdays, Sundays, and public holidays not allowed.
🚫
No guests staying more than 3 days/month — €250 fine applies. Overnight stays of a third party in the communal areas are also not permitted.
🌙
Quiet hours: 10 PM – 7 AM daily. Midday rest: 1 PM – 3 PM. Be considerate of neighbours.
🧹
Keep shared areas clean — kitchen, bathroom, balcony, hallway. Landlord can inspect without notice and charge cleaning costs if neglected.
🔥
Heat the room during winter even when absent (Oct–Apr). Failure to do so causing damage = you pay for repairs.
💧
Run hot water for 5 min after 72+ hour absence to prevent Legionella (required by German law, DIN 1988).
🐾
No pets without landlord's prior written consent.
🌐
Internet for personal/study use only. No illegal filesharing (P2P), no sharing Wi-Fi credentials with others. Violation can lead to immediate termination.
🪟
No nails, pins, posters on walls or doors. No laundry on balcony guardrails. Grill only in designated areas.
🚨
Report any damage in writing immediately. Delay = you become liable for consequential damage even if you didn't cause the original problem.
🗓️
Notify arrival 7 days in advance — both to Mr. Wittmann AND the Housing Office. Fill in the Hof University arrival form.
🏠
Moving out: Arrange with caretaker 14 working days in advance. Hand over by 12:00 noon on last day. Leave all areas spotless or cleaning costs are charged.

🏫 General Hof University Housing Rules

📅
Contracts are 6 or 12 months: Winter semester: Sep 1 – Feb 28. Summer semester: Mar 1 – Aug 31. Yours runs Sep 15, 2026 – Aug 31, 2027.
💡
Utilities vary by property. Your contract includes water, electricity, heating and internet — you are in a good position compared to many other students.
🛡️
Private liability insurance is required. Sign online before arriving — providers like FRIDAY, Getsafe, or HanseMerkur. Choose a policy that includes Mietsachschäden (damage to rented items).
📺
Rundfunkbeitrag €18.36/month — not included in rent but mandatory. One payment per flat. Check with flatmates first. Register at rundfunkbeitrag.de after moving in.
💳
First month + deposit upfront: €785 total due by 11 Sep 2026. Always use the transfer reference saved in Todoist for all transfers to Mr. Wittmann.
